name: Lens Flare
desc: An honest lens rather than a cheesy one — a wandering source throws veiling glare that quietly kills contrast, a chain of dim iris-polygon ghosts re-imaged along the axis through frame centre, cat's-eye squash as they near the edge, and a soft anamorphic streak; everything slow, desaturated and low-alpha by default.

energy.doc: flare strength — veiling glare, source glow, ghost brightness

scale.doc: size of the source, veil and ghost chain

density.doc: how many ghosts sit along the axis

streak.doc: anamorphic horizontal streak length and strength

blades.doc: iris blade count — the ghosts are that polygon

hue.doc: source hue (32 = warm sun); ghosts scatter around it, the veil goes complementary

x.doc: light-source x — the ghost chain mirrors through frame centre

alpha.doc: master opacity over the scene below

seed.doc: ghost spacing, tint, size and rotation seeding
